definitions.explanation: a person or organization that buys goods or services from a business

examples.japanese: {顧客|こきゃく}の{声|こえ}を{大切|たいせつ}にする。
{新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく}を{獲得|かくとく}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to acquire new customers.

examples.japanese: {当社|とうしゃ}は{顧客|こきゃく}{満足度|まんぞくど}の{向上|こうじょう}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: Our company is committed to improving customer satisfaction.

notes:
BUSINESS VOCABULARY:
{顧客|こきゃく} is a formal business term. In everyday conversation, {客|きゃく} or お{客|きゃく}さん is more common.

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {客|きゃく} - customer (casual)
- お{客|きゃく}さん - customer (polite)
- {得意先|とくいさき} - regular customer, client (business)
- クライアント - client (loanword)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顧客|こきゃく}{満足度|まんぞくど} - customer satisfaction
- {顧客|こきゃく}{管理|かんり} - customer management
- {顧客|こきゃく}データ - customer data
- {新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく} - new customer
- {既存|きそん}{顧客|こきゃく} - existing customer
- {顧客|こきゃく}{対応|たいおう} - customer service/handling
